about: Shared test vectors for the script header. The firmware (src/core/script/ScriptMeta.h), the web UI and the AWTRIX Hub each parse the header and each test against this file. vocabulary lists the capability names @needs is checked against on a device; each is a boolean in GET /api/v1/capabilities.

cases.name: needs and display
no header at all
tags and tokens are case-insensitive, tokens come out lowercase
commas, spaces and tabs separate; repeats count once; lines add up
a malformed name is dropped, the rest of the line stays
an @oauth line needs oauth, once, in header order
cases.source:
# @needs gamepad
# @oauth authorize=https://a.example/auth token=https://a.example/token api=a.example
# @needs oauth ble

cases.name: an empty @oauth line needs nothing
an unknown but well-formed name is kept; a device without it reports it missing
at most eight names
cases.source: # @needs a1 a2 a3 a4 a5 a6 a7 a8 a9

cases.name: a name longer than 32 characters is dropped
an empty needs line adds nothing
a # in a needs line starts a comment
cases.source:
# @needs gamepad # for steering
# @needs audio.effect, ble# layered sound
# @needs # nothing but a comment

cases.name: a # in a display line starts a comment
cases.source:
# @display 64x16 # wider than it has to be
# @display 52 x 16# the TC002 panel
# @display # not decided

cases.name: display allows spaces around the x
unusable display values are ignored
the last usable display line wins
the header ends at the first line of code
blank lines, plain comments and CRLF do not end the header
icons: separators, repeats, malformed and overlong names
cases.source:
# @icons sun, rain  sun bad!name
# @icons abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzabcdefg snow_2 fog-1

cases.name: requires: optional Hub id, one entry per line, repeats and bad lines dropped
cases.source:
# @requires Weather abc123DEF456
# @requires Gamepad
# @requires Weather
# @requires bad!name
# @requires Radio tooShort

cases.name: a # in an icons line starts a comment
cases.source:
# @icons sun # weather
# @icons rain,snow# the rest
# @icons # none yet

cases.name: a # in a requires line starts a comment
cases.source:
# @requires Weather abc123def456 # forecast
# @requires fmt # number helpers
# @requires Pad#controller
# @requires # nothing

cases.name: requires: at most eight entries
cases.source:
# @requires r1
# @requires r2
# @requires r3
# @requires r4
# @requires r5
# @requires r6
# @requires r7
# @requires r8
# @requires r9
